Planned location for pinned AgentSociety 2 upstream source if vendoring/submodule is chosen in Phase 1. Upstream source must remain a complete, unchanged unit: no in-place edits, no monkey-patching, no selected-file pseudo-fork.

The pin of record. Adversarial-review finding: it classified as freely-editable production. Changing a pin is an architecture decision requiring a DECISIONS.md entry and the documented exception procedure.
protected_paths.audit_exempt_reason: Born on the implementation branch; PreToolUse blocks edits in every mode, but its presence in the branch diff vs main is its legitimate creation.

import_procedure: Phase 1 initial import only: record a decision entry in .agent-run/DECISIONS.md naming the exact upstream SHA being imported; temporarily remove the affected protected_paths entry in the same session; perform the pristine import (submodule add or complete snapshot copy at the pinned SHA); verify integrity against third_party/UPSTREAM_LOCK.json checksums; restore the protected_paths entry immediately; record the completed import window in DECISIONS.md. Any later change to pinned upstream source requires the directive's fork-or-patch conditions (failing contract test, smallest isolated patch, line-by-line documentation in third_party/PATCHES.md, adversarial-reviewer agreement) and an explicit exception recorded here plus in DECISIONS.md.
notes: PreToolUse denies writes under protected_paths (prefix and glob match).

If Phase 1 instead selects pinned git dependencies (no vendored tree), the planned third_party/<name>/ source directories may stay absent; the entries above still protect against accidental creation of divergent local copies, and third_party/UPSTREAM_LOCK.json remains mandatory either way.
